subject: planner: add the prefix index as candidate for topn optimization (#65533)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent: it introduces `PhysicalProperty.PartialOrderInfo` (with hash inclusion), propagates it through `LogicalProjection.TryToGetChildProp`, adds an extra `PhysicalTopN` candidate carrying PartialOrderInfo (guarded by `OptPartialOrderedIndexForTopN`), and relaxes skyline pruning to keep matching prefix-index paths as candidates. No remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues identified for planner behavior in this commit; later upstream history continues evolving partial-order TopN but does not leave an outstanding Blocker/High attributable to this change.
